note: Seed definitions copied into metrics.json by `init.mjs --seed <set>`. SEO metrics are fully defined by the Search Console model, so they seed as active. Funnel metrics are project-specific, so they seed as proposed with no canonical source until a human confirms each definition.

seo.label: Organic clicks
seo.definition: Clicks from Google organic search results to the property, as reported by Search Console.
limitations: Search Console data lags 2–3 days and is restated for recent days.
Anonymized queries are withheld from query-level rows.

seo.label: Organic impressions
seo.definition: Times a property URL appeared in Google organic results, as reported by Search Console.
limitations: Impression counting depends on result-type rules that Google changes over time.

seo.label: Organic CTR
seo.definition: Organic clicks divided by organic impressions × 100, computed as a ratio of sums over the period (never an average of daily CTRs).
limitations: CTR depends strongly on position; a position change is a confounder for any CTR claim.

seo.label: Average position
seo.definition: Impression-weighted average of the topmost organic position, as reported by Search Console. Not a rank-tracker SERP position.
limitations: Averages hide distribution shifts; a new low-position query can worsen the average while every existing query improves.
